note: Read by scripts/cio_provider_journal_rotate.py (operator-run, NOT scheduled). A semantic key is archived only when its NEWEST row is older than window_days AND its latest state is not in retain_states (an unresolved AMBIGUOUS/DISPATCHED request needs explicit resolution, so it stays live at any age). Every row of a key moves together, so latest() and the attempt count are unchanged for every key still in the live journal. Retry policy (classify_failure) is 3 attempts with a 30 s max interval, so the idempotency window is minutes; 30 days is the audit margin. Archived rows go, byte-for-byte, to the file-prune archive root (retention_archive.file_archive_root() / archive_label) as .jsonl.gz with a sha256 manifest and a RetentionArchiveTripwire@v1 record (AGENTS.md rule 6: never delete).
